name: hindsight
one_liner: A memory system that lets an AI assistant actually remember and learn from past conversations instead of forgetting everything the moment you close the chat.
buyer: A developer building a customer-facing AI assistant (support bot, coding copilot) who needs it to remember a specific user's history and preferences across sessions.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company bolts it onto their support chatbot so it remembers a customer's past tickets and stops asking the same questions every time they return.
An agency building custom AI agents for clients uses it as the memory layer so a client's internal assistant improves the more the team uses it.
A coding-assistant startup uses it to give their tool persistent project memory, competing with tools that forget context between sessions.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'add persistent memory to your existing chatbot' as a paid integration service for SaaS companies.
A hosted managed-memory API tier for startups who don't want to run the server themselves.

steal_this: Bolt this onto an existing support or coding bot you already run and ship a demo this weekend showing it remembering a user across two separate sessions — that's the whole pitch to a client.
